evals.name: Question and review avoid work artifacts
evals.prompt: Explain how this service validates sessions, then review the current implementation for bugs. Do not change code.
evals.expected_output: A one-sentence no-feature assessment followed by read-only investigation, with no feature, plan, or progress mutation.
expectations: Selects no feature
Creates no plan or progress record
Does not run broad verification merely to classify the request

evals.name: Small monorepo edit stays lightweight
evals.prompt: In this large multi-team monorepo, correct one broken link in a subsystem README and verify that the target exists.
evals.expected_output: A no-feature assessment because the requested change is local, clear, reversible, and safe despite repository scale.
expectations: Does not escalate solely because the repository is large
Creates no feature, separate plan, or progress record
Uses only proportional verification

evals.name: Bounded tracked work keeps an inline plan
evals.prompt: Add the approved CSV export backlog item. Its scope and acceptance must remain in repository-local feature state, and implementation is one bounded session with no dependencies.
evals.expected_output: A feature with a concise inline plan, reusing existing feature state and avoiding a separate plan document.
expectations: Selects feature tracking because the backlog is durable project memory
Keeps the plan inline
Does not create an external plan merely because implementation has several steps

evals.name: Cross-system migration gets a separate plan
evals.prompt: Migrate authentication sessions across the web app, API, worker, and database over several releases with rollback support and two agents working in parallel.
evals.expected_output: A feature linked to a separate durable plan covering phases, dependencies, ownership, verification, recovery, and handoff.
expectations: Uses complexity, coordination, impact, and rollback as evidence
Selects a separate linked plan
Keeps feature scope and plan execution details in their canonical artifacts

evals.name: Small high-impact task is not automatically lightweight
evals.prompt: Change one authorization condition that controls access to customer billing records. The diff should be only a few lines.
evals.expected_output: An assessment that escalates based on authorization and data impact, then chooses inline or separate planning according to discovered recovery and coordination needs rather than diff size.
expectations: Does not classify by line count
Inspects relevant scope and safeguards before selecting the artifact level
Does not require a separate plan without durable sequencing or recovery evidence

evals.name: Non-code work follows the same thresholds
evals.prompt: Reorganize and redirect a large documentation set across three teams over multiple sessions while preserving inbound links.
evals.expected_output: A feature with a separate linked plan because coordination, phases, link migration, and recovery matter even though no application code changes.
expectations: Does not classify work by whether it changes code
Selects durable feature and plan artifacts
Updates progress only when execution state materially changes

evals.name: External tracker remains canonical
evals.prompt: Implement the assigned issue. The accessible tracker already contains scope, acceptance, dependencies, status, and handoff, and the repository has no local feature for it.
evals.expected_output: Reuse the external tracker and avoid duplicating it in feature_index.json, a feature file, or progress.md.
expectations: Reuses the canonical tracker
Creates no duplicate local feature state
Still assesses whether execution needs a separate canonical plan

evals.name: No trigger outside Harness Slim
evals.prompt: Classify this task in a repository that has no Harness Slim instructions or feature artifacts.
evals.expected_output: harness-task should not trigger because the repository does not use Harness Slim.
expectations: Does not impose Harness feature or plan artifacts
Leaves repository-native workflow selection to applicable instructions
